gatoh.model.model.ABModel

class ABModel(hierarchy_names: list[str], hierarchy_rw_distributions: list[tuple[float, float]], agent_opinion_rw: tuple[float, float] = (0.0, 0.1), iterations: int = 100, silencing_threshold: float = 0.95, negation_threshold: float = 0.999, radicalisation_threshold: float = 0.99, suppress_warnings: bool = False, visualise: bool = True, visualisation_dir: str = '', vis_aggregation_method: str = 'median', checkpointing: bool = True, save_dir: str = '', data_file: str = '', model_id: str = '')[source]

An agent-based model class that is capable of handling multiple layers that affect agent behaviour.

Parameters:

  • hierarchy_names (list[str]) – The names of all social hierarchies that will exist in the model.

  • hierarchy_rw_distributions (list[tuple[float, float]]) – (mean, variance) parameters used for random walk effects within each hierarchy.

  • agent_opinion_rw (tuple[float, float], optional) – Shared (mean, variance) parameters used for stochastic opinion changes across all agents at each timestep.

  • iterations (int, optional) – The number of iterations that the model will run for.

  • silencing_threshold (float, optional) – A threshold that, when surpassed by agents, will cause them to cease expressing their opinions in a given hierarchy.

  • negation_threshold (float, optional) – A threshold that, when surpassed by agents, will cause their opinion to become its additive inverse.

  • radicalisation_threshold (float, optional) – A threshold that determines how strong of an absolute opinion an agent must hold before they begin to consider becoming radicalised.

  • suppress_warnings (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if non-critical runtime warnings should be suppressed.

  • visualise (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the model should visualise emergent behaviour in real time.

  • visualisation_dir (str, optional) – The path to a directory in which all of this model’s visualiser outputs should be saved to.

  • vis_aggregation_method (str, optional) – The aggregation method that should be used when relevant for visualisation (i.e. ``median’’, ``mean’’, etc.).

  • checkpointing (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the model’s progress should be saved at the end of each iteration (useful in case of interrupted runtimes).

  • save_dir (str, optional) – The path to a directory in which all of this model’s non-logger data should be saved to.

  • data_file (str, optional) – The path to which the logger’s data should be saved to after iterations are run.

  • model_id (str, optional) – A unique ID assigned to this model to make it referencable amongst other models.
